2608.16338.title: SIGMA-Lane: Scale-pyramId Gated MAmba for Temporally Consistent Video Lane Detection
2608.16338.paper_summary: Video lane detection requires predictions that remain stable across frames, yet severe vehicle occlusions can break temporal cues. In streaming recurrent models, corrupted observations may enter the hidden state and produce errors that persist into later frames. Existing occlusion-aware refinements usually provide obstacle masks as auxiliary inputs, so the state-update path is only indirectly protected. We propose SIGMA-Lane, which treats this failure mode as state contamination in State Space Model (SSM)-based temporal modeling. SIGMA-Lane places occlusion-aware gates on the SSM write and residual-fusion paths, controlling how current observations enter temporal memory and are fused back after temporal propagation. After coordinate-consistent affine alignment, the model combines two complementary paths: SSM-consistent dual-gating for temporal filtering and Structural Spatial Retrieval (SSR) for recovering missing lane structure from aligned historical priors. Experiments on VIL-100 and OpenLane-V show improved temporal stability under heavy occlusion, with competitive F1 and mIoU scores.
2608.16338.paper_summary_zh: 視頻車道檢測需要在幀之間保持穩定的預測，但嚴重的車輛遮擋可能會破壞時間線索。<lb/>在流式遞歸模型中，損壞的觀測值可能會進入隱藏狀態並產生持續到後續幀的錯誤。<lb/>現有的考慮遮擋的改進通常提供障礙物掩碼作為輔助輸入，因此狀態更新路徑僅受到間接保護。<lb/>我們提出了SIGMA-Lane，將這種失效模式視為基於狀態空間模型（SSM）的時間建模中的狀態污染。<lb/>SIGMA-Lane 在SSM的寫入和殘差融合路徑上設置了考慮遮擋的閘，控制當前觀測值如何進入時間記憶並在時間傳播後重新融合。<lb/>經過坐標一致的仿射對齊，該模型結合了兩條互補路徑：SSM一致的雙閘用於時間過濾，以及結構空間檢索（SSR）用於從對齊的歷史先驗中恢復缺失的車道結構。<lb/>在VIL-100和OpenLane-V上的實驗顯示，在重度遮擋下的時間穩定性有所改善，並且F1和mIoU得分具有競爭力。
